name: Lightning Tools
description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents. Buy credits with Bitcoin Lightning.

services.name: Validate an email address
services.description: Validates an email address and returns a comprehensive quality signal including syntax, DNS, MX, disposable check, role account detection, free provider detection, domain age, and a 0-1 quality score.

services.name: Evaluate a mathematical expression
services.description: Evaluates arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, logarithms, unit conversions, and natural language math.

services.name: Generate a QR code
services.description: Generates a QR code as a base64 PNG string or SVG string.

services.name: Extract text from a URL
services.description: Fetches a URL and extracts clean readable text using Mozilla Readability.

services.name: Validate a phone number
services.description: Validates and parses a phone number using libphonenumber-js.

services.name: Apparent temperature
services.description: Calculates the apparent (feels-like) temperature using heat index or wind chill.

services.name: Solar times
services.description: Calculates sunrise, sunset, solar noon, and day length for a given location and date.

services.name: Age calculator
services.description: Calculates age in multiple units from a birthdate.

services.name: Amortisation calculator
services.description: Calculates loan payoff schedule including months to payoff, total interest, and total paid.

services.name: Compound interest calculator
services.description: Calculates compound interest with year-by-year breakdown.

services.name: Elo chess rating calculator
services.description: Calculates new Elo ratings after a match.

services.name: Password strength analyser
services.description: Calculates password entropy and estimated crack time.

services.name: Boiling point at altitude
services.description: Calculates the boiling point of water at a given altitude.

services.name: Horizon distance calculator
services.description: Calculates the distance to the geometric and radio horizons from a given height.

services.name: Speed of sound calculator
services.description: Calculates the speed of sound in a given medium at a given temperature.

services.name: Resource reality check
services.description: Checks whether a URL is reachable and gathers signals about DNS, HTTP, SSL, and content.

services.name: Scam signal check
services.description: Analyses domain age, MX configuration, email deliverability, and payment method for scam signals.

services.name: Data freshness check
services.description: Checks URL reachability, domain update recency, SSL validity, and content word count for data freshness signals.

services.name: Get current date and time info
services.description: Returns the current date, day of week, UTC offset, DST status, working day status, week number, quarter, days until month/quarter end, next working day, and upcoming holidays.

services.name: Convert datetime between timezones
services.description: Converts an ISO 8601 datetime from one IANA timezone to another, including UTC offset and DST info.

services.name: Check if a date is a working day
services.description: Returns whether a date is a working day for a given country, including holiday details if not.

services.name: Find next or previous working day
services.description: Finds the next (or previous) working day after a given date, skipping weekends and public holidays.

services.name: Add working days to a date
services.description: Adds N working days to a date (negative = backward), skipping weekends and public holidays.

services.name: Count working days in a date range
services.description: Counts working days between start and end (inclusive), excluding weekends and public holidays.

services.name: Find days all countries are available
services.description: Returns working day availability for 2-5 countries over a date range (max 90 days), identifying days when all countries are simultaneously available.

services.name: Find overlapping working hours across timezones
services.description: Finds the UTC window where all specified timezones are simultaneously within working hours.

services.name: DNS lookup for a domain
services.description: Returns A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS records and derived signals: spf_present, dmarc_present, mx_count.

services.name: WHOIS / RDAP lookup for a domain
services.description: Returns registrar, registration date, expiry date, domain age in days, and days until expiry.

services.name: HTTP probe — status, redirects, content type, response time
services.description: Follows redirects (max 10), records the full chain, and returns final status code, content type, and response time in ms.

services.name: TLS/SSL certificate inspection
services.description: Inspects the TLS certificate for a domain: validity, expiry date, days remaining, issuer, SANs, and hostname match.

authentication.description: API key from POST /api/v1/credits/verify after paying Lightning invoice
